description: Turn a payment list (JSON rows or CSV) into a bank-ready SEPA XML file: credit transfer pain.001 or direct debit pain.008 (versions 2009 to 2019), validated against the official XSD, IBAN and creditor-ID checks, next TARGET2 business day, rejected rows listed with the reason. Also mode=check (validate an existing SEPA file) and mode=upgrade (old pain version -> current). Runs on our server, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.01/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/sepa-xml.

csv.description: Or the payment list as CSV text with a header line

name.description: Your company name (payer for transfers, creditor for debits)

rows.description: Payments: name, iban, amount, reference (+ bic, mandate_id, mandate_date for debits)

xml.description: SEPA XML text for mode check / upgrade

title: SEPA XML Generator - pain.001 credit transfer + pain.008 direct debit
